Every town and village has a Notice Board next to its gatekeeper. Each day it posts a few quests, and the town's own people (its blacksmith, grocer, warehouse keeper...) pin their requests there too.

These quests are made for you: their monsters and hunting grounds follow your level, and grow with your party. Choose a difficulty: Easy, Normal, Hard or Elite. The harder it is, the better it pays.

You can read the board from anywhere with .quests or Bounties and Requests on the Community Board (Alt+B), and take its offers there. Requests are only taken at the board itself.

Sometimes a herald runs up to you in the wild with a quest. You may accept it or turn it down.
